questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

Can you describe a typical Vietnamese meal? What food is usually in it?
questions.sampleAnswer: A typical Vietnamese meal is very simple but delicious. We usually eat steamed rice with some meat or fish. We also have a bowl of vegetable soup and some fish sauce. My family always eats together in the evening.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What is your favourite time of the year, and why?
questions.sampleAnswer: My favourite time of the year is autumn. The weather is very cool and dry, so I can go out with my friends. I also love autumn because we have the Mid-Autumn Festival with many beautiful lanterns.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What do you like doing in your free time?
questions.sampleAnswer: In my free time, I like listening to music and reading books. Sometimes, I play football with my friends in the park. I love doing these activities because they help me relax after a busy day at school.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Describe the picture.
questions.sampleAnswer: In this picture, I can see a beautiful, sunny outdoor grass football pitch. There is a group of five young people playing football together. They are wearing casual sportswear, like comfortable t-shirts, shorts, and sports shoes. One young man is running very fast with the ball. Another player is trying to tackle him to get the ball back. The other three players are running into good positions on the field. They all look very energetic, focused, and happy. In the background of the picture, there are some tall green trees and a clear blue sky. I think they are good friends and they are having a wonderful time together on a nice day.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Tell me about the last time you played or watched a football match.
questions.sampleAnswer: The last time I watched a football match was last Sunday. I watched it on TV with my father at home. It was a match between Vietnam and Thailand. The game was very exciting because both teams played very well. In the end, Vietnam won the match. My father and I were very happy and we shouted loudly. It was a great evening.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

What are the benefits of playing sports?
questions.sampleAnswer: Playing sports has many great benefits for everyone. First, it helps us stay healthy and strong. When we play sports, we can lose weight and have more energy. Second, sports are very good for our minds. It helps us reduce stress after a busy day of studying or working. Finally, we can make new friends and learn how to work in a team.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Compare these two pictures.
questions.sampleAnswer: In the first picture, I can see a young person playing an acoustic guitar alone in a cozy living room. The room looks very comfortable and quiet. In contrast, the second picture shows a musician playing on a big stage. There are bright lights and a very large audience watching the show. The first picture is about playing music at home, which is very private and calm. But the second picture is about a public concert, which is exciting and energetic. Playing at home is for relaxing, but playing on stage is for entertaining other people. I think both places are great for music, but they are very different. The home is silent and personal, but the stage is loud and crowded.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

How do you think the people in the two pictures feel?
questions.sampleAnswer: I think the person in the first picture feels very relaxed and happy. He is playing music for himself, so he does not feel any stress. However, the musician on the stage probably feels very excited but also a little nervous. There are many people watching him, so he wants to play perfectly. He must feel a lot of energy from the crowd.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

How does playing music in different places bring different feelings?
questions.sampleAnswer: Playing music in different places changes how we feel. At home, music is like a quiet friend. It helps us forget our worries and feel peaceful because nobody is judging us. But on a stage, music becomes a big show. It makes us feel powerful and happy because we can share our energy with other people. Both feelings are very good.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 4 - Discuss an abstract topic

I'd like you to talk about a time when you were in a hurry. Please say what happened, why you were in such a hurry, and what you did.
questions.sampleAnswer: I remember a time when I was in a hurry to catch a bus to my English class. It was last summer, and my class started at 7 p.m. I was at home, doing my homework, when I looked at the clock. It was already 6:35. The bus stop was about ten minutes from my house, and the bus usually came at 6:45. I quickly put my books, notebook, and water bottle in my bag. Then I ran out of the house. I did not eat dinner because I had no time. On the way, I called my friend and asked her to tell the teacher that I might be late. Luckily, I caught the bus just before it left. In that situation, I felt very worried and nervous. My heart was beating fast, and I was tired after running. However, I felt happy when I got on the bus. I think people today are busier than people in the past because we have work, study, phones, and many things to do every day.
